name: nextjs-auth0
description: Teaches coding agents how to add Auth0 authentication to Next.js apps with @auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4, including MFA, Organizations, and passkeys.

interface.shortDescription: Add Auth0 auth to Next.js with MFA, Organizations, and passkeys
interface.longDescription:
Agent skills for @auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4. This plugin teaches coding agents how to install and configure the Auth0 Next.js SDK for App Router and Pages Router: Auth0Client setup, middleware/proxy route mounting, env config, useUser, getSession/getAccessToken, and protecting pages and API routes.

Use it when adding login to a Next.js app, wiring Auth0 middleware, protecting routes, or implementing step-up MFA, multi-tenant Organizations, or passkey signup/sign-in with the server-side auth0.passkey.* API. Skills live in skills/ (core, mfa, organizations, passkeys) and are the same guidance shipped in this repository.

Point agents at the skill docs rather than reading package source. Prerequisites are Next.js ^14.2.35, ~15.0.7 / ~15.1.11 / ~15.2.8 / ~15.3.8 / ~15.4.10 / ~15.5.9, or ^16.0.10, and an Auth0 Regular Web Application.
defaultPrompt: Add Auth0 authentication to this Next.js App Router project with @auth0/nextjs-auth0
Implement MFA step-up when calling a sensitive API with @auth0/nextjs-auth0
Add passkey signup and sign-in using auth0.passkey.* in this Next.js app
